name: renach-mock
description: Mock funcional da jornada RENACH (TR 575 → 181-E → 159 Motivo 5): React + NestJS + banco em memória. Dados fictícios.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
